buildCommand: cd cria_app && if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable; fi && ./flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" && if [ -f build/web/assets/.env ]; then echo 'ERRO: segredo .env vazou para o bundle web' && exit 1; fi
